Container.Name: Cuesheet
Container.Overview: Cuesheet is a calm media dashboard for your server: what's playing on Plex and Jellyfin right now, what was recently added, what Radarr and Sonarr expect this week, and a box to request new media through Overseerr or Jellyseerr. Open the web UI after starting and a setup wizard walks you through connecting each service and testing it. Everything about your services is configured inside Cuesheet, so there is nothing to fill in here beyond the port, a folder for its settings, and an optional admin password. Everyone in the house can sign in with their existing Plex or Jellyfin account; you decide who is an admin, and everyone else can be kept from seeing who is watching. All API keys stay inside the container, stored in the config folder. The browser only ever talks to Cuesheet.
Container.Changes:
### 1.0.0
First release.
- Now Playing, Recently Added, a weekly release calendar and Seerr requests on one page. - Setup wizard with live connection tests, so no variables need filling in here. - Sign in with Plex or Jellyfin, an admin list you control, and viewer privacy for who is watching. - Demo mode for a look before anything is connected.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the dashboard is served on.

Config.Name: Config Folder
Config.Description: Settings saved through the in-app setup wizard are stored here.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Optional shared password; you can also set one in the app, and enable Plex/Jellyfin sign-in there. Admins can open Settings and see who is streaming.

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Set to 1 only if Cuesheet sits behind a reverse proxy, so sign-in rate limits see the real client address.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns the config folder.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns the config folder.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA time zone used for the weekly calendar.
